\begin{algorithm*}[!t]
\caption{Frozen-Evidence Factorial Audit Protocol}
\label{alg:frozen-evidence-audit}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require Dataset and immutable IDs $D$; feature contract $F$; inherited backbone $B$; split $S=(S_{tr},S_{dev},S_{te})$; task metrics $M$
\Ensure Claim ledger $L$ and hashed evidence package $A$
\State Define experimental object $O=\{D,F,\text{prompt},\text{pooling},B,S,M\}$; changing any member creates a new object.
\State Separate the \emph{inherited backbone}, each \emph{audited factor}, and each train-only \emph{training intervention}.
\State Predeclare factors, matched contrasts $C$, seeds $R$, dev selection metric $m_{dev}$, test policy, and claim gates $G$.
\ForAll{$(c,r)\in C\times R$}
  \State Train with $S_{tr}$ and select only with $S_{dev}$ using $m_{dev}$; freeze the selected checkpoint.
  \State If the dev/integrity gate passes, execute the frozen $S_{te}$ inference exactly as preregistered; never reselect from test.
\EndFor
\State Join treatment/control predictions using immutable sample, dialogue, utterance, speaker, and gold-label IDs.
\State Report task metrics, robustness, paired-utterance uncertainty, and training-seed variability as separate evidence layers.
\State Hash features, configurations, checkpoints, and predictions; archive seeds, commands, logs, environment, and hardware records.
\State Assign each claim to \textbf{Supported}, \textbf{Restricted}, \textbf{Rejected}, \textbf{Untested}, or execution \textbf{No-Go}; do not upgrade wording beyond its gate.
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm*}
